answer_1.quote: Story generation tasks can be considered as a test bed for examining whether a system develops a good understanding of the narratives ... We conduct human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) over four aspects: relevance, interestingness, logicality, overall.
answer_1.outputs: Planned verb‑phrase events and full textual stories

answer_2.quote: We first tested the diversity of the generated sequences and calculate Distinct-1 and Distinct-2 scores to measure the diversity for all generated events.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) over four aspects: relevance (whether the story is related to the topic), interestingness (whether the story content and style are interesting), logicality (whether the story is logical), and overall (overall quality).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare stories on relevance, interestingness, logicality, and overall quality.
